note: THE HEAVY-TIER COST CLAIM ON THE HEARSAY BATTERY IS WRONG BY TWO ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE, MEASURED. windows/hearsay/tests/common/mod.rs says a world build at Settlements depth is minutes, and hop_depth_seed42.rs is ignored with the reason live-worldgen battery (minutes). Measured on the real subject at c9fb7701: cargo test -p hornvale-hearsay --test hop_depth_seed42 -- --ignored ran in 4.31 s, real 7.34 s including the build, and reproduced every published number exactly (pairs=7778 median=4 tail_ge_10=0.1535 max=21 echo=0.2727 over 408 endings divergent=0.4632). Two lighter probes on the same seed-42 world at the same depth ran in 1.96 s and 6.40 s. This is consistent with the census doing about 2000 worlds in about 950 s, i.e. roughly half a second per world - so the minutes figure predates The Local Census and The Whetstone and nobody re-measured it. CONSEQUENCE: campaign 1 preregistered readouts are deferred out of the commit gate for a cost that does not exist, which means they do not run in make gate and a regression in them is invisible. Before you write a heavy: ignore reason, time the thing. Before you trust one, time it again.
